The '''1991 [[Tippeligaen]]''' was the 47th completed season of top division [[association football|football]] in [[Norway]]. 22 game-weeks were played with 3 points given for wins and 1 for draws. Number eleven and twelve are relegated. The winners of the two groups of the [[1. divisjon]] are promoted, as well as the winner of a series of play-off matches between the two second placed teams in the two groups of the 1. divisjon and number ten in the Tippeligaen.

The season began on 27 April 1991. The season ended on 13 October 1991, with [[Viking FK|Viking]] claiming their eighth league title. Viking were thus the last club to win the league before [[Rosenborg BK|Rosenborg]]'s 13-year domination started.
